entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The fervent desire of the prophet to confirm the church in God's promises. 6 The office of the ministers (unto which they are incited) in preaching the Gospel, 10 and preparing the people thereto.

Zion's. 6,7; Ps 51:18; 102:13-16; 122:6-9; 137:6; Zec 2:12; Lu 10:2; 2Th 3:1 Heb 7:25 the righteousness. 1:26,27; 32:15-17; 51:5,6,9; 61:10,11; Ps 98:1-3; Pr 4:18; Mic 4:2 Mt 5:16; Lu 2:30-32; Php 2:15,16; 1Pe 2:9
